subject.title: fix(cron): skip heartbeat-enabled checks for cron-sourced main-session wakes (#101537)

question: Should this PR be expanded to cover scheduler admission, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101584 own the complete cron wake fix?
rationale: Both branches overlap on the downstream gate, but only the sibling currently covers the confirmed scheduler admission failure; maintainers should select one branch rather than land competing partial implementations.

options.title: Use the sibling PR
options.body: Make the sibling canonical if its scheduler implementation passes review and receives sufficient real behavior proof.

options.title: Expand this PR
options.body: Add scheduler admission and queued-path tests here, then close the sibling after this branch becomes complete and proof-positive.
